Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 2431 West Thomas Street, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: | RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 2,982.72 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to redevelop the subject property with a new
three-story residential building containing three (3) dwelling units and a
detached garage. The proposed building will measure 38 ft. in height. The
subject property is a Transit Served Location and will be supported by three
(3) off-street parking spaces (2 interior + 1 detached garage space). Pursuant
to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation
and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street
parking ratio for a Transit Served Location to 100% (three (3) parking
spaces for three (3) residential units), reduce the front setback from 15 feet
to 8 ft.-6 in., reduce the east side setback to 1 ft. (west side setback to be 3
ft.), reduce the total combined side setback to 4 ft., and is seeking all zoning
telief, as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the
attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 4,227 square feet (1.42 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 994.24 square feet per D.U.
(3 residential units)

(C)  *The amount of off-street parking: 3 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Western Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to increase the
required number of off-street parking spaces from two (2) parking spaces (66%) to
three (3) parking spaces (100%).

(D) _ Setbacks:
a. *Front Setback: 8 feet-6 inches
b. *Side Setbacks:
East Side: 1 feet
West Side: 3 feet
com Rear Setback: 37 feet-4 inches

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce front setback

from the required 15 ft. to 8 ft.-in., reduce the east side setback to 1 ft, (west side
setback to be 3 ft.), and reduce the total combined side setback to 4 ft.
